CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `author_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `title` TEXT NOT NULL, `body` TEXT NOT NULL, `word_count` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, FOREIGN KEY(`author_id`) REFERENCES `authors`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE )

indices.name: index_articles_author_id
indices.createSql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_articles_author_id` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`author_id`)

contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_articles_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `articles` BEGIN DELETE FROM `articles_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_articles_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `articles` BEGIN DELETE FROM `articles_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_articles_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `articles` BEGIN INSERT INTO `articles_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `body`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`body`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_articles_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `articles` BEGIN INSERT INTO `articles_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `body`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`body`); END
entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`title` TEXT NOT NULL, `body` TEXT NOT NULL, tokenize=unicode61, content=`articles`)
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS3(`note` TEXT NOT NULL, `tag` TEXT)

views.createSql: CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT articles.id AS article_id, articles.title AS title, authors.name AS author_name, articles.word_count AS word_count FROM articles INNER JOIN authors ON authors.id = articles.author_id
CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT author_id, COUNT(*) AS article_count, SUM(word_count) AS total_words FROM articles GROUP BY author_id
